items.summary: Fix the backend authorization logic so that Admin users (principals with admin role) are accepted for all actions currently gated to 'users only', including creating comment lists, adding templates, uploading, and any other actions that currently throw 'Unauthorized: Only users can add comment lists'. Admins must be treated as authorized for all user-level operations.

Remove the separate 'Earnings' tab from the main navigation in App.tsx and merge its content (the EarningsChecker view) directly into the Live Checker tab/view, so users can access earnings lookup within the Live List/Live Checker section without a separate tab.
